sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 900. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 60 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
